title: WTP standard profile (core/library/wtp/profiles/<id>.json)
description: A set of design criteria and defaults for one code, country or reference. The engine never hard-codes a criterion; it reads it from the active profile.

units.description: Display units. Stored values are SI.

criteria.description: '<stage>.<type>' -> parameter -> { value | min | max, unit, source:{ref, loc} }.
